name: Snapmaker PLA Wood @U1 0.4 High Flow nozzle
filament_notes: Temperature, flow ratio, pressure advance and other high-flow overrides are based on Snapmaker OrcaSlicer snorca/main b1831e5dcb for 0.4 mm nozzles. Volumetric speed ceiling is 3x the inherited non-HF value for this diameter: 18 x 3 = 54 mm^3/s. This is a configured ceiling, not measured nozzle throughput. Calibrate for your nozzle and filament.
